title: Three-Phase Unbalance Mitigation via DSO-FRA Coordination: A GNB-Based Chance-Constrained Model Considering PV Uncertainty
summary: Although flexible resource aggregators (FRAs), represented by electric vehicle aggregators (EVAs) and load aggregators (LAs), possess inherent flexibility to mitigate three-phase unbalance, the key challenge lies in how to effectively incentivize them to actively participate in unbalance mitigation. To address this, this paper proposes a generalized Nash bargaining (GNB)-based chance-constrained coordinated operation model for the distribution system operator (DSO) and FRAs.
